# `csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable`

Blank lines before and after each method or constructor. 0 means leave the author's.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("run");
    }
    public void Stop()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("stop");
    }
    public void Reset()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("reset");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("run");
    }

    public void Stop()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("stop");
    }

    public void Reset()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("reset");
    }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable = 1`*
